items.name: theme
items.title: Ndigo theme
items.description: Ndigo brand tokens (--nd-*) plus the opt-in base layer for native elements.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Import `styles/ndigo-tokens.css` before the base layer. Set `data-theme="light"` for the light palette; leaving it unset follows the operating system.

items.name: lib
items.title: Ndigo element foundation
items.description: Shared light-DOM custom-element base and the Zag.js machine controller.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy-in foundation for `<nd-*>` elements: the `NdElement` lifecycle base and `createZagElement`.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with focus trapping, dismissal, and ARIA wiring from the Zag.js dialog machine.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-dialog>` with `trigger`, `content`, `title`, `description`, and `close-trigger` parts. Emits `nd-open-change`.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with roving highlight, typeahead, and dismissal from the Zag.js menu machine.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-menu>` with `trigger`, `content`, `item`, and `separator` parts. Emits `nd-select` and `nd-open-change`.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Native-first button styles with variants and sizes; no runtime and no custom element.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-button` to a native `<button>` (or `<a href>` for navigation). Variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger; sizes: sm, md, lg.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Responsive application frame with a skip link, banner, primary nav, sidebar, main landmark, and footer.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy the markup into a layout and replace the `<main>` contents; keep the skip link first and the landmarks unique.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Native text inputs and textareas with focus, disabled, and invalid states.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-input` to a native `<input>` and `nd-textarea` to a `<textarea>`; pair with a `label` and `aria-describedby`.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, help, and error scaffolding for native form controls.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Wrap a labelled control in `nd-field`; use `nd-label`, `nd-help`, and `nd-error`, and `aria-invalid` for the state.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox and radio
items.description: Native checkboxes and radios with the brand accent, focus, and choice-group layout.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-checkbox`/`nd-radio` to native controls; use `nd-choice` rows and a `nd-choice-group` fieldset.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Non-modal overlay with a trigger, positioned surface, title/description, close, and arrow.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-popover>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hint surface with hover/focus delays, arrow, and aria-describedby wiring.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-tooltip>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tablist, roving focus, arrow navigation, and tabpanels.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-tabs>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable items with single/multiple and collapsible modes.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-accordion>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Labelled toggle with a hidden checkbox and the ARIA switch contract.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-switch>` builds the label/input/control/thumb from text markup; emits `nd-checked-change`.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single-value range with track, range, thumb, and keyboard steps.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-slider>` provides track/range/thumb parts, `setValue()`, and keyboard steps; emits `nd-value-change`.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Single transient notification with live-region semantics and auto-dismiss.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-toast>` is a native-first live region with `show()`/`hide()` and an optional duration; emits `nd-open-change`.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-select dropdown with a hidden native select and listbox options.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-select>` derives its collection from `[data-part="item"][data-value]` markup; see the item README.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable single-select with an input, listbox, and filtered collection.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-combobox>` derives its collection from `[data-part="item"][data-value]` markup; see the item README.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Edge-anchored dialog with end, start, bottom, and top placement.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-drawer>` shares the dialog machine; set `placement` to `end`, `start`, `bottom`, or `top`.

items.name: command
items.title: Command palette
items.description: Modal command palette: a combobox inside a dialog, opened with Cmd/Ctrl+K.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy the block and initialize it with `initCommandPalette(document)`; Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the palette and `nd-command` reports the selection.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Popup calendar with an ISO form value, keyboard navigation, and min/max bounds.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-date-picker>` submits an ISO value through a hidden input; see the item README for the grid and keyboard contract.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Styled scrolling viewport with custom scrollbars, corner, and hover/drag states.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-scroll-area>` wraps authored content in root/viewport/content and renders both scrollbars; give it a block size.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Native page navigation with links, a current-page state, ellipsis, and disabled edges.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Use a labelled `<nav>` with `.nd-pagination__list`; the current page is `aria-current="page"` and unavailable edges are `aria-disabled` spans.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with dropdown content, hover/click triggers, and keyboard item navigation.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-navigation-menu>` is the root; author list/item/trigger/content/link parts and mark the current page with `aria-current`.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags input
items.description: Removable tag chips with a hidden form value, max limit, paste parsing, and inline editing.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-tags-input>` generates chips from the machine value; the hidden input joins tags with `", "`.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: Dropzone with accept/size/count validation, a hidden file input, and a removable file list.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-file-upload>` renders a dropzone and file list; the machine owns validation, the hidden input, and accepted files.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Native tables with an overflow wrapper, sortable headers, numeric alignment, and row states.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Wrap `.nd-table` in `.nd-table-wrap`; put `aria-sort` on sortable `<th>` and `data-numeric` on aligned cells.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Sortable, selectable, paged table composed from the table, checkbox, button, and pagination items.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy the block and call `initDataTable(document)`; sorting, page-local selection, and pagination stay client-side.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline status message with info, success, warning, and danger variants.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Use `.nd-alert` with `data-variant` and a `role="status"` or `role="alert"`; the icon and text carry the meaning.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact status label with neutral, accent, and semantic variants.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `.nd-badge` and `data-variant` to a short text element; do not use color alone to convey state.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Content surface with media, header, content, and footer parts.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Compose `.nd-card` with optional `.nd-card__media`/`__header`/`__content`/`__footer`; keep a real link or button inside.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical rule for grouping content.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Use `<hr class="nd-separator">` for thematic breaks; for vertical rules add `data-orientation="vertical"` and `role="separator"`.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder shapes with a reduced-motion-safe shimmer.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Wrap `.nd-skeleton` shapes in `aria-hidden="true"` and announce loading separately.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Rotating loading indicator with sizes and reduced-motion handling.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Give `.nd-spinner` `role="status"` and an accessible name; pair it with visible loading text for longer waits.
